enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf web-presentation boundary for the history command that enforces handler/renderer separation within the file plugin's git-operations family. Sits downstream of handler.ts git-log execution and the centralized adapter dispatcher, owning only AppWeaver WebNode translation and scoped styling with no git or containment logic. Provides the navigational bridge that links the read-only audit-trail surface to diff inspection via dispatched diff actions, realizing the plugin's CLI/web duality at leaf granularity without participating in bottomup lifecycle.

files.web.ts: Sole web adapter for the history feature; encapsulates all WebNodeRoot construction so handler remains focused on path resolution and git execution. Owns the history-to-diff navigation affordance by wiring commit subjects to diff command dispatches, enabling traversal from log overview to single-commit inspection entirely within the web surface.
